description: Connect one Scriber story and discuss your next revision with ChatGPT. Scriber supplies exact manuscript passages, your writing brief, confirmed story-bible facts, prose statistics, and seven custom editorial methods: reader reaction, critique, voice and patterns, pacing, continuity, character and story arcs, and audience positioning. Ask for evidence, compare chapters, and choose practical revision priorities while preserving your voice. The connection is read-only: it cannot edit your manuscript, save reviews, or run paid Scriber generation. Reviews stay in your assistant conversation until you copy them back. You choose one story when connecting and can revoke access at any time. A Scriber account and a ChatGPT account with plugin support are required; these tools need no separate provider API key. Your assistant account's limits apply.

defaultPrompt: Suggest up to three useful opening-chapter revisions. Quote evidence, preserve my voice, and say when no change is needed.
Check continuity against my confirmed story bible. Separate contradictions from intentional mysteries.
Review the pacing of my opening chapter. Where does momentum build or stall, and why?
